title: T cell-targeted immunotherapies for multiple sclerosis: molecular mechanisms to therapeutic perspectives from Traditional Chinese medicine
affiliations: School of Chinese Medicine, Li Ka Shing Faculty of Medicine, The University of Hong Kong
abstract: This review discusses T-cell imbalance in multiple sclerosis, current disease-modifying therapies, T-cell-targeted immunotherapies, oxidative stress, and perspectives from Traditional Chinese medicine.
